gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
